kpis.label: SGI
kpis.methodNote: Derived from the 10_1 telemetry depths: per calendar month, the district's monthly mean depth is ranked over its whole record (shallowest highest) and SGI = Φ⁻¹((r − 0.5) / n) (Bloomfield & Marchant 2013, the SPI family's empirical-normal form). Telemetry is sampled about every seven weeks, so about 38 % of months have no sample and are interpolated linearly first (gaps of at most 2 months), as for the depth forecast; a district needs at least 36 months and at most 20 % of months still missing. In this record the index marks 2015–16 strongly and other droughts weakly, and it does not follow the older SGI (ended Aug 2024), which remains a database variable.
